posts.text:
I grew popcorn this year, and we've just popped it. 🍿

Two little cobs from the garden, dried, kernels twisted off with my thumbs, then into a pan with a splash of oil and the lid on. Turn the sound up for the best bit.

If you fancy trying it next year:
🌱 Sow indoors mid-April to mid-May, one seed per pot
🌽 Plant out in a block, not a row, once the frosts are over
🍂 Leave the cobs on the plant until the husks go brown and papery
🏠 Dry them indoors for 2 to 4 weeks, then pop a few to test

Dried kernels keep in a jar for a year or more, so one small patch gives you plenty of film nights.

The full growing guide and the step-by-step popping recipe are on homegrownplate.co.uk/recipes/stovetop-popcorn/
